core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aghil corresponds to the Arabic form عقيل and is glossed in this record as “Intellect.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
